(a) we can use NLP to detect REs in scientific documents, (b) we can use LOD to detect NEs in scientific documents and (c) we can use semantic web ontologies for linking REs and NEs in scientific publications.
(1) REs can be automatically detected in scientific publications, (2) NEs can be recognized in scientific publications, and (3) NEs and RE can be linked together in RDF triples.
In summary, our research is concerned with

(i) the automatic generation of semantic triples for REs and NEs; (ii) the integration of REs with NEs; (iii) the integration of the generated semantic triples with the LOD cloud; (iv) the use of the generated triples for semantic querying of scientific documents.
